description: AI Whodunit — Turborepo + pnpm + TypeScript. Evidence-gated pipeline with a coder/test-author split, mutation-probing, and a standing adversarial gate. Enforces 100% coverage on deterministic code, real-DB integration, and no hallucinating tests.

code.description: Implement PRODUCTION code only — no tests, no evals

test_author.description: Separate author writes ALL tests + evals to 100% and mutation-probes each

lint.description: ESLint with zero tolerance for warnings
lint.fix_hints: Fix all ESLint errors AND warnings (--max-warnings 0). Do not disable rules to pass; fix the code.

typecheck.fix_hints: Fix all type errors. tsconfig is strict (noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes). No 'any', no '@ts-ignore' to silence errors.

test.description: Vitest unit tests with 100% coverage gate on deterministic packages
test.fix_hints: All unit tests pass AND coverage is 100% (line+branch) on deterministic packages — thresholds live in each package's vitest config and the command fails below them. Never lower a threshold or add coverage-ignore comments to dodge the gate.

mutation.description: Mutation testing (Stryker) — proves tests KILL injected bugs, not just cover lines
mutation.fix_hints: Mutation score must meet the break threshold (Stryker `thresholds.break`, configured per deterministic package). Surviving mutants = vacuous tests: tighten the assertion that should have killed each survivor. Never lower the threshold or exclude code to pass.

test_integration.description: DB integration tests against a real Postgres
test_integration.fix_hints: Integration tests run against a REAL Postgres (never a mocked DB). Migrations apply; assertions check real persisted state.

test_contract.description: API/contract tests incl. the server-authoritative payload scan
test_contract.fix_hints: Contract tests assert tRPC/SSE behavior against a real test DB, including that NO client-bound payload contains any dossier field, secret, or isGuilty. LLM behavior uses recorded-fixture replay, not exact-string asserts.

test_e2e.description: Playwright end-to-end the full play flow
test_e2e.fix_hints: Drive the real app in a real browser through the full play flow. Do not stub the UI.

test_smoke.description: Smoke — every route loads without error
test_smoke.fix_hints: Every route must load without console/network error.

test_visual.fix_hints: Screenshot baselines for board, interrogation, accusation, paywall. Only update baselines when the visual change is intended.

code_review.description: Review for correctness, the grounding invariant, and test honesty

adversary.description: Standing adversarial gate — argue AGAINST the change; hunt vacuous tests, silent inversions, leaked ground truth
